newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says discovers new gas field.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says discovers new gas field.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Thursday it had discovered a new gas field in the South Australian section of the Cooper-Eromanga basin.

Santos said the exploration well, Merindal 1, flowed gas at 137,355 cubic metres per day (4.85 million cubic feet per day) with 123 barrels of condensate per day from the interval 2,196 metres to 2,207 metres.
The test was run through a 13mm (0.5 inch) choke.

Santos, which earlier announced the discovery of a new oil field in the Cooper-Eromanga Basin, said Merindal 1 was located five km southeast of Bookabourdie Field and about 65 km northeast of the Moomba gas plant.

Santos, as operator, has a 79.96 percent interest in Merindal 1. Boral Energy Resources Ltd has 13.19 percent, Crusader Resources, a unit of Clyde Petroleum Plc has 4.75 percent and Basin Oil NL, a wholly owned subsidiary of Cultus Petroleum NL, owns 2.1 percent.
